lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots are distributed in a semi-regular 2D lattice across the lateral flank, forming approximately five identifiable horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of lighter pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like arrangement on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, each characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The distal portion of the pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of small, high-luminance spots distinct from the larger grid pattern on the flank.
